name: Boys & Girls Club of Greenwich Summer Camps
description_short: The Boys & Girls Club of Greenwich runs weekly day camps from June 22 to August 14, 2026: Clubhouse Camp (ages 6-12) at its Horseneck Lane clubhouse, Camp Simmons (ages 6-12) on 77 wooded acres at 744 Lake Avenue, and Teen Camp (ages 13-15), plus a Counselor-in-Training program. Camp is $275 a week ($200 for CITs) plus the annual club membership, which you need before you can register.
swim_waterfront_notes: Clubhouse Camp has a 25-meter pool and offers swim lessons. Camp Simmons has an outdoor swimming pool and a pond used for fishing and canoeing. Teen campers can use the swimming pool.
refund_policy_summary: Refund requests made before May 8 at 5:00 pm carry a $70 non-refundable fee. No refunds after May 8. Membership is non-refundable, and membership and registration are not transferable.
special_needs_notes: A child with special health care needs must have an individual plan of care form before camp starts. If your child has an aide at school, you must arrange a similar aide for camp.
